reference_records.link: measured ppm series -> response coefficient A1 -> molecular descriptors and film analyte interaction energy -> GFA QSAR
reference_records.conclusion: true prior experimental sensing and predictive structure-response method; not commercial MQ

reference_records.title: Sensor Material Selection and Response Modeling for the JPL Electronic Nose Using Molecular Modeling Tools
reference_records.link: Hansen cohesion + analyte molar volume or QSAR/GFA interaction descriptors
reference_records.conclusion: molecular interaction and sensor material features should be modeled separately

reference_records.title: Characterization of Unknown Events Observed by the Third Generation JPL Electronic Nose Using Sensor Response Models
reference_records.link: unknown event sensor responses -> QSAR/MD candidate descriptors -> SMAC compound reference list
reference_records.conclusion: SF6 proposed as POSSIBLE identity; not definitive identification

reference_records.title: Machine-learning-enabled exploitation of gas-sensing descriptors: A case study of five pristine metal oxides
reference_records.sensor: SnO2 ZnO In2O3 NiO Cr2O3 fabricated research MOS
reference_records.link: sensor material+gas molecular features+measurement state -> predicted response to eight VOCs
reference_records.conclusion: material/gas dependent forward sensitivity learning; not tested on MQ modules

reference_records.title: Machine-learning for discovery of descriptors for gas-sensing: A case study of doped metal oxides
reference_records.link: 872 literature examples, 34 descriptive features -> genetic algorithm optimized neural network -> key gas sensing descriptors
reference_records.conclusion: cross study sensor chemistry learning with material context

reference_records.title: Physicochemical and statistical characterization of gas-sensing behaviors of resonator sensors with carbonaceous films
reference_records.link: QSPR/LSER descriptors -> gas partition coefficients / sorption response
reference_records.conclusion: separate absorption/partition physics from chemiresistive sensor response

reference_records.title: Towards the design of artificial sensing materials via quantum-informed explainable AI
reference_records.link: quantum properties/interactions -> CatBoost SHAP prediction binding features
reference_records.conclusion: quantum features for sensing material interactions; not calibrated real MQ gas

reference_records.title: Comparing molecular representations, e-nose signals, and other featurization, for learning to smell aroma molecules
reference_records.link: 114 odorants with molecule features vs QCM responses for perceptual odor descriptions
reference_records.conclusion: odor descriptor labels not equivalent to molecular gas identity or ppb

reference_records.title: Bio-Benchmarking of Electronic Nose Sensors
reference_records.link: measure class similarity and limits of intercompound differentiation
reference_records.conclusion: functional-class discrimination may be stronger than intraclass identification

reference_records.link: CID/InChIKey/SMILES/XLogP/TPSA/H bond donor-acceptor and structural properties
reference_records.conclusion: provides chemical features but no MQ calibration response

proposed_next_benchmark.heldout_protocol: leave-one-concentration-out (3 folds) and separate leave-one-molecule-out for transfer claims
comparators: Forward molecular descriptor to sensor response prediction
All candidate inverse ranking with unknown concentration optimized only in defined range
Fusion with open-set and calibrated abstention
leakage_prohibitions: Never supply descriptor of true test gas as per-row feature; do candidate-wise forward predictions
No pretraining on heldout molecular identity for leave-one-molecule-out claims
Do not fit scaler, features, probability calibration on heldout data
limits: Single MQ channel is non-identifying for multiple gases at unknown concentrations unless sufficient discriminative evidence
Small six-molecule source inadequate to claim new molecular structure generalization
No Tank G3 calibration or physical field validation

caution: PubChem molecular descriptor data are not measured gas sensor responses; explicit lab data and device-specific calibration are required.
